Hi Irene,

Quick note — we have an internal engineering milestone and want to run a targeted evening stress sprint against the Redwood sandbox to validate tail-latency under sustained throughput. The plan is a 6 hour window (10:00pm–4:00am PDT) next Tuesday night where we'll drive steady QPS (~250 rps, ~180k tokens total) and a few 1k-concurrency spikes.

Can Redwood provide an ephemeral credit boost (trial/sandbox fuel) for this run? Ideally: 250k token credit + a 48 hour sandbox extension so we can do a quick follow-up soak. We'll tag all requests with project=thalia-llm and env=nonprod.

Why this matters: our models show a tail-latency regression above 2s for 1k concurrency; we want to confirm if batching/prefetch settings on Redwood change the shape. This is a POC-to-deal activity — if the soak looks good we plan to accelerate the Dedicated conversation.

Attached: short test plan (thalia_evening_stress_plan.pdf).

Thanks — appreciate any fast turn here.
